description: Read an app's accessibility tree through the macOS Accessibility API (default: the frontmost app's focused window). Returns {app, snapshot_id, window, complete, elements:[{i, d, role, title, value, states, actions, frame}]}; i is the element_index for mac_click, mac_get, mac_set_value, mac_type, mac_scroll and mac_drag — unique across snapshots (an index never names an element of a later snapshot) and valid 30 s; an action first re-identifies the element and returns element_no_longer_valid if it is gone, moved or replaced. Options: interactive (only actionable elements), compact (default true: skip empty layout wrappers), skeleton (shallow map with children_count) then root (an element_index to drill into; adds new indexes to the same snapshot), surface (window|menubar|menu|sheet|alert|dialog|popover|focused|app), window (index or title) or window_id (from mac_windows), depth (logical depth, default 12, 1-40), max_nodes (default 400), web_accessibility (default true, false under NORACU_READ_ONLY=1: sets AXManualAccessibility on Electron/Chromium apps to expose web content, never AXEnhancedUserInterface which alters window behaviour; the result's web_accessibility is enabled / already_on, exposed when the app refused but its pages are in the tree anyway, or unsupported with a web_accessibility_hint — Google Chrome refuses it). window_identity unverifiable marks a window without a window ID: element_index actions in it are refused. ax_empty when the app has no readable window.
name: mac_ax_state
